title: MindHelper: Closed-Loop Embodied Mental-State Reasoning for Precision Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2606.01063v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning enables embodied agents to understand human beliefs, goals, and intentions, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate this ability through offline question answering or scenario-level action prediction. MindPower advances embodied ToM by introducing robot-centric reasoning from perception to action; however, it does not evaluate whether an agent can continuously interact with a changing environment and intervene only when assistance is needed. Building on MindPower, we introduce the MindHelper Challenge, which extends embodied ToM evaluation to real-time closed-loop precision intervention. An agent must continuously observe the environment, maintain actor-specific beliefs, identify when a human requires assistance, generate executable actions, and remain silent when intervention is unnecessary. translated_title: MindHelper：用于精准干预的闭环具身心理状态推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.01063v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：心理理论（ToM）推理使具身智能体能够理解人类的信念、目标和意图，但现有基准主要通过离线问答或场景级动作预测来评估这种能力。MindPower通过引入从感知到行动的机器人中心推理，推进了具身ToM研究；然而，它并未评估智能体是否能够与不断变化的环境持续交互，并仅在需要帮助时进行干预。基于MindPower，我们引入了MindHelper挑战赛，将具身ToM评估扩展到实时闭环精准干预。智能体必须持续观察环境，维护特定于行动者的信念，识别人类何时需要帮助，生成可执行的行动，并在无需干预时保持沉默。我们进一步提出了MindClaw，一个简单而有效的爪式框架，集成了特定于行动者的信念模块。
tldr: 本文提出了MindHelper挑战和MindClaw框架，将具身心理理论评估扩展到实时闭环精准干预，使智能体能够持续观察环境、识别人类需求并在必要时进行干预。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the MindHelper Challenge and MindClaw framework, extending embodied Theory-of-Mind evaluation to real-time closed-loop precision intervention, enabling agents to continuously observe environments, identify human needs, and intervene when necessary.
